# Zignuts Technolab

> > AI-powered software development agency specializing in custom web/mobile apps, blockchain solutions, LLM integration, and software rescue services for startups and enterprises.

Zignuts offers full-stack development expertise across Node.js, Python, TypeScript, React, and AWS infrastructure, with deep focus on generative AI, natural language processing, and workflow automation. The site features technical guides, AI model references, and case studies demonstrating their agile development approach.

## Key Topics

- AI & LLM Integration
- Node.js & TypeScript Development
- React & Frontend Frameworks
- Python & FastAPI
- Natural Language Processing
- Generative AI Solutions
- AWS & Cloud Infrastructure
- Mobile App Development (iOS/Android)
- Blockchain & Smart Contracts
- Webflow Automation
- Full-Stack Development
- Software Rescue & Legacy Modernization
- Custom Software Development
- Agile & MVP Development
